response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced (15+ years) staff-level generalist engineer with strong fundamentals, TypeScript/Node depth, testing/craftsmanship culture, mentoring and workshop leadership, and some recent exposure to agentic tooling (MCP code generators and frameworks) at re:cinq. However, the resume does not evidence the core requirement of 8+ years shipping production AI solutions: there is no Python in the skills list, no RAG or vector database work, no LLM evaluation/observability or multi-agent framework experience, and limited cloud-AI architecture beyond AWS CDK for a pricing service. He looks like a credible senior/staff platform engineer who could grow into GenAI delivery, but he is currently well short of the applied-GenAI depth this Staff FDE role demands.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production systems, staff-level scope and mentoring track record
Recent hands-on MCP and agentic-workflow tooling; strong TypeScript/Node and cloud/K8s/Docker delivery
Proven customer-facing/consulting and teaching ability (Altom consulting, workshops, conference talks)
concerns: No demonstrated 8+ years of production AI/ML work; GenAI exposure is roughly one year
Missing key stack: Python, vector databases, RAG, LLM evaluation/optimization, multi-agent frameworks
Little evidence of large-scale data pipeline design for structured/unstructured data or cloud AI architecture

key_factors.factor: Depth of senior engineering and technical leadership
